ev.q: During February 26–May 13, CDPH confirmed 57 shelter A–associated measles cases, including 52 among residents, three among staff members, and two among community members
Among all cases, 16 (28%) occurred among persons who had documentation of ≥1 measles vaccine dose ≥21 days before first known exposure
Most persons (41; 72%) did not have documentation of measles vaccination and were considered unvaccinated.
By March 11, a total of 1,666 (93%) of 1,801 residents at shelter A had documentation of receipt of ≥1 dose of measles vaccine.
The percentage of measles cases among persons with a history of previous vaccination was higher than that reported through recent national surveillance
CDPH immediately instituted outbreak investigation and response activities in collaboration with state and local health departments

methods_quotes.q: A shelter A–associated case was defined as an RT-PCR–confirmed, wild-type measles infection in a person with a shelter A measles exposure
defined as receipt of ≥1 recorded measles vaccine dose
Two persons with unknown or no rash onset were included by symptom onset date.
